findings.summary: The Fish script still iterates one line per completion, but format_completion now emits three lines (type, value, help) per item. The script therefore errors or yields no candidates for every command.

format_completion replaces real newlines with a literal backslash-n in the value and help, and Fish never reverses this. Values containing newlines are inserted incorrectly, and descriptions show a literal \n.
The test test_fish_multiline_help_complete only checks that \n appears in the help line. It never runs the Fish script, so it passes despite the parsing bug.
The docstring says versionchanged:: 8.3, but CHANGES.rst lists the change under Unreleased, after 8.3.3, so the version number is probably wrong.
